verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents sending events to 200+ third-party destinations from one SDK or API. Its Transformations feature lets you filter, enrich, and reshape events with JavaScript or Python before they reach destinations, and a community user reports routing all their analytics through it successfully. missing for 10: explicit documentation that mapping and filtering are configured per destination (rather than globally), detail on per-integration field-mapping docs, independent hands-on corroboration of destination-level filtering.
